answer.reasoning: The two suggestions share a theme: the ability checks now accept prom-only rules, but parts of the UI still require ruler data. They still point at different code and describe different problems, and each needs its own fix. s_1f77ab04 is about RuleActionsButtons.V2. There, SilenceGrafanaRuleDrawer only mounts when rulerRuleType.grafana.alertingRule(rule) is true. With a prom-only rule, clicking Silence does nothing. The fix is to let the drawer accept a GrafanaPromRuleDTO, or to pass it folderUid and labels. s_8955a30a is about AlertRuleMenu. There, the MenuItemPauseRule and Delete items check that rulerRule exists, so they never render in the list view. The fix is to render those items for promRule and wire the pause and delete handlers to the prom uid. These are different actions in different components. A single find-and-replace won't fix both, and fixing one leaves the other broken. Calling them a systemic_pattern would mean merging them on a shared theme rather than on a repeated copy of the same mistake. Judge 2's reading is defensible, though, because both come from one general cause: UI gates that still depend on rulerRule. So I'm marking this as a judgment call, not a clear-cut decision.
